copy.tagline: 用 BLoC 架构构建 Flutter 应用功能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用 Flutter 和 BLoC 模式开发移动应用
copy.tagline_en: Build Flutter features with BLoC architecture
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building Flutter apps with BLoC pattern

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照 BLoC 模式、分层架构和设计系统常量来构建 Flutter 功能。它会创建 feature 文件夹、BLoC 文件、数据层和 UI，并确保所有代码符合项目规范。
howto.when: 当你要求创建新屏幕、新 widget、集成数据或重构现有 Flutter 代码时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个新的 earnings 功能，包含 BLoC 和数据层。
say.note: Claude 会生成完整的 feature 文件夹结构。

say.text: 给这个页面添加一个加载状态和错误处理。
检查这个 widget 是否有硬编码的颜色或间距。
say.note: Claude 会扫描代码并建议替换为设计系统常量。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will build Flutter features using BLoC state management, clean architecture layers, and the project's design system. It creates feature folders, BLoC files, data layers, and UI, enforcing all project conventions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create a new screen, widget, integrate data, or refactor existing Flutter code.

say_en.text: Create a new earnings feature with BLoC and data layer.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the full feature folder structure.

say_en.text: Add loading state and error handling to this page.
say_en.note: Claude ensures BLoC emits Loading then Success/Error.

say_en.text: Check this widget for hardcoded colors or spacing.
say_en.note: Claude scans code and suggests design system constants.
